nyheter.title: 80,000 Tons of Liberté
nyheter.summary: PARIS — The namesake of France’s next nuclear aircraft carrier isn’t a place or a person. It’s an idea. At 80,000 tons, FS France Libre will be the largest warship in France’s history when it is delivered to the Marine Nationale in 2038.
